display.purpose: Hero statement. One per page, Spectral Light.

body.purpose: The unhurried read. 17px at lh 1.65, capped 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Buttons, kickers, metadata, nav. Uppercase at 0.16em.

shadows.name: menu-drop
shadows.purpose: The open financing mega-menu, so it reads as detached from the header.

shadows.name: concierge-lift
shadows.purpose: The floating concierge badge. Tinted emerald rather than neutral gray so it belongs to the palette.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: The open concierge dialog. Emerald at low opacity — presence without weight.

motion.name: ease-gentle
motion.purpose: The one easing in the system. Exponential ease-out: fast arrival, long settle. Never a bounce, never a snap.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered section reveals, fired once per element.

motion.name: distance-reveal
motion.purpose: Vertical travel on a reveal. Zeroed under prefers-reduced-motion, which crossfades in place.

motion.name: duration-color
motion.purpose: Button and link color transitions. Color only — no size, no lift.

motion.name: duration-arrow
motion.purpose: The CtaLink trailing arrow's 2px diagonal drift on hover.

motion.name: duration-panel
motion.purpose: Concierge panel enter and exit: opacity, 12px rise, 0.98 to 1 scale.

components.css: .ds-concierge-fab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.875rem 1.25rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.25rem; background: var(--emerald, oklch(0.34 0.05 165)); color: var(--emerald-foreground, oklch(0.965 0.012 92)); font-family: "Albert Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px oklch(0.34 0.05 165 / 0.3), 0 4px 6px -4px oklch(0.34 0.05 165 / 0.3); outline: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, var(--gold, oklch(0.72 0.105 86)) 30%, transparent); transition: background-color 300ms ease-out; } .ds-concierge-fab svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; color: var(--gold, oklch(0.72 0.105 86)); } .ds-concierge-fab:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--emerald, oklch(0.34 0.05 165)) 90%, transparent); } .ds-concierge-fab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--gold, oklch(0.72 0.105 86)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-concierge-fab:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-concierge-dot { position: relative; display: inline-flex; width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; } .ds-concierge-ping { position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--gold, oklch(0.72 0.105 86)) 70%, transparent); animation: ds-ping 1.4s cubic-bezier(0, 0, 0.2, 1) infinite; } .ds-concierge-core { position: relative; width: 0.5rem; height: 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--gold, oklch(0.72 0.105 86)); } @keyframes ds-ping { 75%, 100% { transform: scale(2); opacity: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-concierge-ping { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
This system feels like being shown around a beautiful home by someone who genuinely wants you to stay. It is Japandi — the calm meeting of Japanese restraint and Scandinavian warmth, drawn directly from the project's brochure: warm wood, organic textures, plaster-soft walls, and a spa-like quiet. Color is committed but never loud. A cream/marble canvas carries the page; sage green is the ambient brand voice; a single deep-emerald voice marks every place the visitor is invited to act; and a rare brass-gold (the brochure's logo metal) appears as a jewel accent, brightest on the dark sage and emerald surfaces.

It is built on shadcn (Tailwind v4, base-ui primitives). The semantic tokens in the frontmatter are the contract: components consume primary, secondary, muted, accent, border, and friends, plus three brand tokens — gold, sage, emerald — for the moments the page leans into color. Surfaces are matte rather than flat: a limewashed plaster texture exists so a brand color reads as a wall, not a fill.

Motion is choreographed and gentle, never decorative. Scroll-driven reveals ride an exponential ease-out over 0.8s with a 24px lift; site-wide smooth scrolling runs on Lenis; a hairline reading-progress bar tracks the top of the viewport. Everything honors prefers-reduced-motion — Lenis never starts, reveals crossfade in place with no travel, and the concierge's ping and typing dots go static.

It explicitly rejects four things, carried from PRODUCT.md: it must not look like generic SaaS / proptech, like a listings portal, like luxury-flex, or like corporate sterile templates. Gold is handled with care precisely so it never tips into luxury-flex: it is a thin accent and a metal on dark green, never a shiny button on black.
keyCharacteristics: Cream/marble canvas, sage ambient voice, one emerald action voice, rare brass-gold accent
Sage- and emerald-drenched bands (footer, announcement bar, CTA) keep the page from reading as cream monotone
Limewashed plaster texture so brand surfaces read as material, not as hex
Editorial whitespace and an unhurried reading rhythm
Spectral serif display (light, with italic emphasis) paired with Albert Sans body
Uniformly soft corners: 4px on controls, 6px on panels; full-bleed bands run edge-to-edge. No hard 0px corners — that consistency is the warmth
Photography and warm material carry the emotion, not borders or chrome

rules.name: The One Action Voice Rule
rules.body: Emerald (primary) marks where the visitor acts: the inquiry CTA, links, and focus. Gold decorates; emerald acts. Don't repaint decoration emerald or buttons gold.

rules.name: The Gold-on-Dark Rule
rules.body: Gold is a metal: it sings on emerald and sage, and whispers (or disappears) on cream. Use it for accents and on dark surfaces, never for body text on the cream canvas.

rules.name: The Neutral-Accent Rule
rules.body: shadcn's accent is a sage-stone hover wash, not a brand color. Never repaint it emerald or gold.

rules.name: The Intent-Not-Hex Rule
rules.body: Author-facing surfaces (the announcement bar) store a named intent — EMERALD, GOLD, SAGE, INK — that resolves to tokens in code. No hex ever reaches the database, so nothing off-brand or unreadable can be published.

rules.name: The Printed-Page Rule
rules.body: Body type is set for sustained reading: 17px, line-height 1.65, lines capped at 65-75ch.

rules.name: The Three-Tracking Rule
rules.body: Only three tracking values for uppercase text: label (0.16em) for buttons and nav, kicker (0.22em) for section labels, monogram (0.3em) for the wordmark. No arbitrary tracking in markup.

rules.name: The Kicker-as-Voice Rule
rules.body: The brochure's labelled-section device (THE PROPERTY, THE CONCEPT) is used deliberately and sparingly via the Kicker component — it is brand voice, not a reflex above every block.

rules.name: The Tonal-Layer Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with warm tone steps, not shadows. A shadow appears only as a real response to state (an open menu, an open dialog, the concierge badge), never as default decoration.

rules.name: The Warm-Shadow Rule
rules.body: When a shadow is warranted it is tinted emerald, never neutral black. A gray shadow on this cream canvas reads as dirt.

rules.name: The Gentle Arrival Rule
rules.body: Elements ease in; they never bounce, snap, or slide aggressively. The one easing is cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1).

rules.name: The No-Hard-Corner Rule
rules.body: Nothing interactive is 0px. If a control looks square, it is a bug — the uniform 4px is what makes the system feel warm rather than clinical.

dos: Do lead with warmth, photography, and material; let tonal cream → sage → emerald layers carry structure.
Do reserve emerald (primary) for inquiry actions, links, and focus.
Do use gold as a rare jewel accent, brightest on dark sage/emerald surfaces — plus the one active-nav underline.
Do reach for .surface-plaster when a brand-colored band needs to read as a wall rather than a fill.
Do set body type at 17px / lh 1.65 / 65-75ch.
Do align every section to .main-container, including the contents of full-bleed bands.
Do ease motion in on cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
Do tint a shadow emerald on the rare occasion one is warranted.
donts: Don't look like generic SaaS / proptech, a listings portal, luxury-flex, or corporate-sterile.
Don't put gold body text on cream (low contrast) or gold buttons on black (luxury-flex).
Don't set body copy on sage — it carries large type only. Use emerald when a dark band needs paragraphs.
Don't use pure #000/#fff, side-stripe accent borders, gradient text, or decorative glassmorphism.
Don't repaint shadcn's accent; it is the neutral sage-stone hover wash.
Don't add a shadow as decoration, or a neutral-gray shadow at all.
Don't ship a theme toggle. .dark exists for shadcn parity only; light is the committed theme.
Don't invent a new z-index above the ladder in Layout.
Don't invent facts, prices, or contact details — the brochure (/public/brochure.pdf) and lib/site.ts are the source of truth.
